name: podcast-continuation
label: Podcast Continuation
prompt:
You are continuing an in-progress, natural two-person podcast conversation between a Host and a Guest discussing "{{topic}}" in {{language}}. Below is a recap of the most recent lines already written - continue DIRECTLY from there, matching the same tone, pacing, and level of familiarity. Do NOT repeat a welcome/intro, do NOT re-introduce the topic, and do NOT summarize what was already said. Return ONLY valid JSON without markdown formatting.

Recap of the most recent lines (already written - do not repeat these, continue after them):
{{recap}}

Rules:
- Return STRICT JSON only, no additional text
- Continue writing the NEXT {{sceneCount}} scenes (generate exactly this number) - each scene is exactly ONE dialogue turn (one person speaking), numbered sceneNumber starting at {{startSceneNumber}} and increasing by 1 each scene
- Alternate speakers naturally: "speaker" must be either "host" or "guest" for every scene, continuing naturally from whoever spoke last in the recap
- Keep the same real back-and-forth energy as the recap - agreement, pushback, teasing, reactions, not a pure interview
- MECHANICAL RULE - do not skip this: at least 1 out of every 4 scenes must be a SHORT standalone reaction of 2-6 words and NOTHING else (example audio.text values: "Wait, really?" | "Exactly." | "Huh." | "Oh, come on." | "Right, right." | "No way.") - this is its own separate scene with its own sceneNumber, never folded into the start of the next longer turn. The remaining scenes are longer turns (about {{wordsPerScene}} words, 1-2 sentences). Reach the ~{{wordCount}}-word total across all {{sceneCount}} turns through this uneven mix of short and long turns, not uniform-length turns
- Use contractions and short natural reactions ("Right," "Exactly," "Wait, really?", "Hmm, I'm not so sure," "Fair point," "Oh, come on"), no stiff narration
- sceneType must always be "image" for every scene
- imagePrompt must be left as an empty string (the shared cover art from earlier in the episode is reused automatically)
- {{closingInstruction}}
- audio.text is that scene's spoken line; audio.voice should be left as an empty string
- Write in natural, conversational {{language}}

Required JSON format (scenes array ONLY - do not include title/description/tags/thumbnailPrompt, those were already generated earlier):
{
  "scenes": [
    {
      "sceneNumber": {{startSceneNumber}},
      "sceneType": "image",
      "speaker": "host",
      "title": "",
      "subtitle": "",
      "backgroundColor": "",
      "transition": "fade",
      "imagePrompt": "",
      "cameraMotion": "static",
      "animation": "",
      "audio": {
        "text": "",
        "voice": ""
      }
    }
  ]
}
